name: jobnavigator-local
description: JobNavigator Local — self-hosted job-search and application management app

scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace=apps/api && npm run typecheck --workspace=apps/web && npm run typecheck --workspace=packages/shared
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace=apps/api && npm run lint --workspace=apps/web && npm run lint --workspace=packages/shared
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace=apps/api && npm run test --workspace=apps/web && npm run test --workspace=packages/shared
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=packages/shared && npm run build --workspace=apps/api && npm run build --workspace=apps/web
scripts.smoke: npm run smoke --workspace=apps/api && npm run smoke --workspace=apps/web
